label: MEASURED
method: atrace (am wm view dalvik res bionic ss, app tracing for every package) around each `am start -W`; 3 warm-up starts after a speed compile, then 12 rounds cold-starting every arm once in rotating order. Phases are slices of the app process (the one that runs bindApplication), summed per launch; TotalTime is under tracing, so slower than untraced. Raw traces (about 4 MB each) are not committed; the parser was a scratch script.
